title: Digital Portfolio & Web CV Studio 10/10 Overhaul (Live Customizer, Vanity Slugs, Responsive Themes & OpenGraph Social Sharing)
spec:
# DIR-019: Digital Portfolio & Web CV Studio 10/10 Overhaul

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
The Digital Portfolio & Web CV Studio (`src/components/PortfolioBuilder/PortfolioBuilder.jsx`, `WebCvStudio.jsx`, `PublicPortfolio.jsx`, `CreateWebCvDialog.jsx`, and `PortfolioTemplates/`) allows job seekers to publish a live, interactive personal website showcasing their work, resume, case studies, and contact form.
Currently, `PortfolioBuilder.jsx` (102KB) contains legacy styling and lacks an executive split-screen editor experience, responsive viewport toggles, and unified Cuba Executive tokens.

This directive mandates a complete 10/10 overhaul of the Portfolio Studio into a modern, Google-inspired live website builder with a split-screen customizer, responsive viewports, vanity slug validation, 1-click resume data import, and dedicated Playwright E2E verification.

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Split-Screen Studio Customizer Layout**:
   - Modernize `PortfolioBuilder.jsx` into an executive 2-pane workspace:
     - **Left Pane (Configuration Inspector)**: Collapsible accordion panels for:
       - Header & Bio (Full name, title, avatar, tagline, social links)
       - About & Career Story (Rich markdown bio)
       - Skills Matrix (Categorized technical & soft skills)
       - Projects & Case Studies (Cards with images, tech stack badges, live demo & GitHub links)
       - Work History & Education
       - Contact & Inquiry Form
       - Theme & Style Presets (Minimalist, Tech Modern, Executive Glass, Creative Bold)
     - **Right Pane (Live Scaled Preview)**:
       - Interactive preview of the Web CV updating in real time as the candidate edits.
       - Viewport switcher bar: Desktop (1440px), Tablet (768px), Mobile (375px), and Open Fullscreen in new tab.

2. **Vanity Slug Availability & Domain Manager**:
   - Integrated URL bar: `ime365.com/portfolio/[your-name]` with real-time debounced availability check against the backend.
   - Clean validation badge (e.g. '✓ Available' in emerald or '✕ Already taken' in amber).
   - Publish toggle: 'Draft / Private' vs 'Published / Public'.

3. **1-Click Sync from Resume Data**:
   - Seamless data bridge: Allow candidate to click 'Import from Active Resume' to pre-populate all experience, education, skills, and projects without manual re-typing.

4. **Public Portfolio Presentation & Social Sharing**:
   - `PublicPortfolio.jsx`: Render high-performance, accessible public view with zero layout shifts.
   - Integrated OpenGraph metadata tags so shared links on LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and Twitter render stunning preview cards.

5. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Verification**:
   - Author `playwright.dir019.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir019-portfolio-builder.spec.js`.
   - Verify editor panel switching, live preview updates, slug validation, and public route access against the live stack with zero mocks.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).
INV-2: Zero XSS & Sanitization Discipline: User portfolio markdown, custom text, and links must be strictly sanitized using DOMPurify / sanitizeHtml before rendering in public DOM.
INV-3: Authentic MariaDB Grounding: All portfolio data and vanity slugs must read and persist exclusively to authoritative MariaDB tables with zero synthetic local arrays.
INV-4: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility: Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 across all public portfolio templates in both light and dark themes.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Sub-100ms live preview update latency; production bundle build duration < 4.0s.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Tokenize Portfolio Studio: Replace all legacy styles across PortfolioBuilder.jsx, WebCvStudio.jsx, and PublicPortfolio.jsx with Cuba Executive design tokens (--cuba-canvas, --cuba-card, --cuba-elevated, --cuba-line, --cuba-ink, --cuba-ink-muted, .cuba-btn-primary, .cuba-btn-outline).

AC-2: Split-Screen Live Preview Customizer: Modernize PortfolioBuilder into a professional split-pane studio: configuration drawer on left (profile, skills, projects, experience, contact, theme preset, custom CSS accent), real-time live preview on right with responsive viewport switcher (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile).
AC-3: Vanity Slug & Live URL Checker: Real-time availability check for candidate custom portfolio URL (ime365.com/portfolio/:slug) with instant debounced validation against MariaDB.
AC-4: 1-Click Sync from Resume: Provide a 1-click 'Import from Resume' button that automatically populates the portfolio with candidate work experience, skills, and projects from their active resume.

AC-5: Public Web CV Presentation & OpenGraph Meta: PublicPortfolio.jsx must render beautifully across all screen sizes with rich SEO meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card) so links shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and WhatsApp display professional preview cards.

AC-6: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir019.config.js & tests/e2e/dir019-portfolio-builder.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying portfolio creation, theme switching, viewport toggling, live preview rendering, and public view accessibility.
AC-7: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

AC-8: Zero CSP Violations & Production CSS Preload Integrity: The portfolio studio (/portfolio/builder?edit=:id) must load reliably in production builds on ime365.local with zero Content Security Policy violations and zero CSS preload errors. Decouple legacy Puck CSS (@puckeditor/core/puck.css which references blocked external fonts from rsms.me) from the modern studio bundle.

AC-9: Null-Safe Dashboard & Public Route Guarding: DashboardPortfolios.jsx must never emit href='/portfolio/null'. Portfolios without a published slug must route their primary action to /portfolio/builder?edit=:id or render an explicit 'Draft' badge. Public route /portfolio/:slug must handle null/invalid slugs gracefully.

plan.summary: DIR-019 audit complete (all baselines green: portfolio tests 16/16 + 3/3, frozen diff=0, dev:3000 up, api:8080 up). FINDINGS: (1) PortfolioBuilder.jsx line 1123-1125 ALREADY delegates to <WebCvStudio/> unless ?legacy=1, so the 99.8KB Puck legacy branch is dead-by-default. (2) WebCvStudio.jsx is currently a 3-COLUMN grid (18rem|1fr|22rem), NOT the AC-2 2-pane split, and carries 21 raw slate/gray/blue Tailwind hits (AC-1 gap). Viewport modes exist but lack real 1440/768/375 scaling + fullscreen. (3) AC-3 vanity slug is 0% built AND BLOCKED: MySQLRepository.savePortfolio L919 pins slug as 'ownerRows[0].slug || generatedSlug' with a mandatory 8-char sha256 suffix, so a true vanity slug is impossible without changing the repository. (4) AC-4 resume import exists (convertResumeToPortfolio + CreateWebCvDialog) but has no persistent 1-click header button. (5) AC-5 PublicPortfolio already emits og:title/description/type/url, canonical, JSON-LD, robots, but is MISSING og:image + twitter:image and uses twitter:card=summary (AC-5 requires rich cards).
steps: 1. Backend: add isPortfolioSlugAvailable to MySQL+InMemory repos and GET /api/portfolios/slug-available (additive
2. Repository: honor explicit data.slug on first publish while preserving already-published URLs and PORTFOLIO_SLUG_CONFLICT
3. Frontend: add checkPortfolioSlugAvailability API + pure slug normalizer

4. WebCvStudio: rebuild to AC-2 2-pane split (accordion config drawer left, live scaled preview right) with Cuba tokens (AC-1), 1440/768/375 switcher + fullscreen, vanity URL bar w/ debounced availability badge (AC-3), Import-from-Resume header button (AC-4)
7. Gates: build<4s, eslint 0, test:portfolio + test:product green, frozen diff=0 (AC-7)

evidence.summary: Both gatekeeper defects fixed + 3 new E2E cases. DEFECT 1: Puck CSS decoupled - legacy Puck extracted to src/components/PortfolioBuilder/LegacyPuckEditor.jsx loaded via React.lazy; PortfolioBuilder.jsx no longer statically imports @puckeditor/core/puck.css. Build proves it: dist/assets/PortfolioBuilder-*.js now has NO CSS sibling, and 'rsms.me' appears ONLY in the async LegacyPuckEditor-*.css (never in eagerly-linked index.html stylesheets), so the CSP-blocked remote @import and the 'Unable to preload CSS' fatal render are unreachable on the default studio route. CSP also allowlists rsms.me as defense-in-depth. DEFECT 2: getPublicPortfolioHref() in DashboardPortfolios.jsx returns null unless isPublished===true AND slug is a real non-sentinel string, so grid AND list views omit the eye link for drafts instead of rendering href='/portfolio/null' (drafts still get an 'Open in Studio' action). PublicPortfolio.jsx added normalizePortfolioSlug() so the :slug param fails fast without hitting /api/portfolios/public/null. EVIDENCE: playwright.dir019.config.js 9/9 passed (36.3s) incl. new AC-7 (draft via ?edit=:id renders 2-pane studio, no RouteErrorBoundary, zero 'Unable to preload CSS', zero Puck stylesheet requests), AC-8 (zero /portfolio/null hrefs in both grid+list), AC-8b (/portfolio/null fails closed, no network call, no canonical). AC-8b CAUGHT A REAL LEAK on first run: the error path wrote a self-referential canonical for unavailable portfolios; canonical is now written ONLY for a portfolio that actually rendered. npm run build clean at 3.58s (under 4.0s budget). npm run test:product 639 pass / 0 fail (the single ats-score timing flake seen under concurrent build load passes 24/24 in isolation and is in the FROZEN ATS engine). Frozen INV-1 files verified at git diff = 0.

reviews.feedback: DIR-019 Execution Plan APPROVED in ACT mode. Proceed with the 7-step plan under Option A: 1) Additive slug availability endpoint /api/portfolios/slug-available. 2) Rebuild WebCvStudio into Google/Cuba 2-pane customizer (drawer left, live scaled preview right). 3) 1440/768/375 viewport modes + fullscreen. 4) 1-click Import from Resume header button. 5) OpenGraph rich social sharing cards. 6) Dedicated Playwright E2E suite playwright.dir019.config.js. Quality gates: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, 100% tests pass, INV-1 diff strictly 0 bytes.

[LEAD ARCHITECTURAL REVIEW & SURGICAL INSTRUCTIONS — DIR-019 PLAYWRIGHT TEST HARNESS]

Cline, outstanding progress on DIR-019. The test run in .bridge/evidence/dir019-results.json reveals that:
- Tests 1, 2, 3 (AC-1 / AC-2 two-pane split, disclosures, 1440/768/375 viewport modes) are 100% GREEN.
- Test 4 (AC-3 MariaDB authoritative slug availability verdict) is now 100% GREEN following your JSON parsing fix.
- INV-1 (git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js) remains strictly 0 bytes.

The two remaining failures in tests/e2e/dir019-portfolio-builder.spec.js are purely test-harness assertion bugs with simple 1-minute fixes:

1. AC-4 (line 245): Modal Pointer-Event Interception
   - DIAGNOSIS: Navigating directly to `/portfolio/builder?create=1` opens the `CreateWebCvDialog` overlay modal (`role="dialog" aria-modal="true" z-[80]`), which intercepts pointer events when trying to click `getByTestId('portfolio-import-resume')` in the background header.
   - FIX: Call `await openStudio(page);` at the start of Test 5 (just like Tests 1-4 do). `openStudio(page)` dismisses the dialog by creating a blank private draft, bringing the studio to the foreground where `portfolio-import-resume` is unblocked and directly clickable.

2. AC-5 (line 269): Main Landmark Selector Mismatch
   - DIAGNOSIS: The test asserts `await expect(page.locator('#cuba-main-content')).toHaveCount(1)`. However, `/portfolio/:slug` is a public route mounted in `src/main.jsx:509` inside `<main id="main-content">`, NOT `#cuba-main-content` (which only exists inside `CubaAppShell` on authenticated portal routes).
   - Your fix in `PublicPortfolio.jsx` replacing `<main>` with `<div>`/`<section>` is 100% correct, and line 268 (`locator('main') count == 1`) passed!
   - FIX: In `tests/e2e/dir019-portfolio-builder.spec.js` line 269, update the locator from `#cuba-main-content` to `#main-content`:
     `await expect(page.locator('#main-content')).toHaveCount(1);`

Apply these two surgical adjustments to `tests/e2e/dir019-portfolio-builder.spec.js` and re-run:
`npx playwright test --config=playwright.dir019.config.js`
The entire 6-test suite will pass 100% green within 20 seconds. Submit evidence immediately upon completion for formal Gatekeeper certification.

[LEAD ARCHITECTURAL REVIEW & CRITICAL DEFECT TRIAGE — DIR-019 PORTFOLIO STUDIO]

Cline, real browser testing on live production host (ime365.local) has uncovered two critical runtime defects demonstrated by user screenshots:

1. DEFECT 1: 'Application View Error' on /portfolio/builder?edit=:id (Screenshot 1)
   - REPRODUCTION: Navigating to /portfolio/builder?edit=portfolio_2c597e03-b7ef-4d58-9261-a9f4a7145e5b crashes with RouteErrorBoundary 'Application View Error'.
   - ROOT CAUSE DIAGNOSIS:
     a) On production host (ime365.local), public/.htaccess enforces Content Security Policy (CSP): style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com.
     b) In PortfolioBuilder.jsx line 5, static import '@puckeditor/core/puck.css' is bundled into PortfolioBuilder-*.css.
     c) node_modules/@puckeditor/core/dist/index.css line 1 contains `@import "https://rsms.me/inter/inter.css";`.
     d) The browser blocks https://rsms.me/inter/inter.css due to CSP violation.
     e) Vite's preload-helper throws `Error: Unable to preload CSS for https://ime365.local/assets/PortfolioBuilder-*.css`.
     f) RouteErrorBoundary catches this unhandled render error and displays 'Application View Error'.
     g) Furthermore, PortfolioBuilder.jsx already delegates to WebCvStudio (line 1123: `if (!wantsLegacyBuilder) return <WebCvStudio />;`). Eagerly importing legacy Puck and its CSS on the default studio route bloats the bundle and triggers this fatal CSP crash.
   - ARCHITECTURAL REMEDIATION:
     - In PortfolioBuilder.jsx, remove the top-level eager `import '@puckeditor/core/puck.css';` and `@puckeditor/core` import. Only dynamically/lazily load legacy Puck if `?legacy=1` is explicitly requested.
     - Modern WebCvStudio uses Cuba design tokens and webcv.css, and has ZERO dependency on Puck CSS.
     - As defense-in-depth, update public/.htaccess CSP if needed, but primary fix is decoupling Puck CSS from the modern studio bundle.

2. DEFECT 2: Navigation to /portfolio/null (Screenshot 2)
   - REPRODUCTION: Clicking 'View' on any draft/unpublished portfolio in /dashboard/portfolios navigates to http://ime365.local/portfolio/null and displays 'Portfolio Unavailable: Portfolio not found'.
   - ROOT CAUSE DIAGNOSIS:
     - In src/components/Dashboard/DashboardPortfolios/DashboardPortfolios.jsx lines 204 and 272:
       `<Link to={'/portfolio/${portfolio.slug}'} ...>`
     - When a portfolio is an unpublished draft or has no vanity slug issued (confirmed in MariaDB where slug is NULL for draft rows), `${portfolio.slug}` evaluates to literal string 'null'.
     - This produces href='/portfolio/null', which routes to PublicPortfolio with slug='null', querying /api/portfolios/public/null -> 404.
   - ARCHITECTURAL REMEDIATION:
     - In DashboardPortfolios.jsx (both card and table list views):
       Only link to `/portfolio/${portfolio.slug}` IF `portfolio.isPublished && portfolio.slug`.
       If unpublished or slug is missing, route the action to `/portfolio/builder?edit=${portfolio.id}` (or render a distinct 'Draft — Open Studio' action / disabled state), ensuring href='/portfolio/null' is NEVER rendered.
     - In PublicPortfolio.jsx: ensure slug === 'null' fails fast cleanly.

3. VERIFICATION & E2E HARNESS UPDATE:
   - In tests/e2e/dir019-portfolio-builder.spec.js, add test cases:
     a) Loading an existing draft portfolio via `/portfolio/builder?edit=:id` renders the 2-pane studio without RouteErrorBoundary or CSS preload errors.
     b) DashboardPortfolios renders zero links with href='/portfolio/null'.
   - Verify build: `npm run build` and live test pass with 0 errors.
